title: fix(telegram): restore ACP live replies in progress stream mode
body: Closes #195899 ## What Problem This Solves Fixes missing replies in Telegram topics bound to ACP sessions when ACP uses live delivery and Telegram uses progress mode. ## User Impact Users receive ACP replies in the originating Telegram topic instead of having to read them in the session transcript. ## Why This Change Was Made Telegram buffers answer blocks in progress mode but incorrectly reports them as already visible. ACP then skips its existing final-delivery recovery, leaving the buffered answer unsent. Report these buffered blocks as non-visible so the existing recovery path can deliver them. Keep the visible result for blocks whose content already exists in a partial preview. Adds a regression test covering buffered-block delivery receipts and subsequent final delivery. ## Evidence ### Before/after replay: ACP replies in a bound Telegram topic BASE: `07492118be0953acd2af7cc74a1038e61f1851c0`\ HEAD: `35653740d1ab699e37b73ee0795f614b432f2814` Method: run an isolated Gateway with Telegram progress mode enabled and a persistent ACP binding to a forum topic. Send a request from that topic asking the ACP agent to return a unique marker. Use the same configuration and scenario on BASE and HEAD, with a fresh marker for each run. Capture the originating topic, the ACP response, the buffered-answer path, and the resulting Telegram delivery. Match the reply to the originating topic using consistent redacted identifiers. | Observation | BASE | HEAD | | --- | --- | --- | | ACP produces the requested answer | `Yes - answer present in the ACP session` | `Yes - answer present in the ACP session` | | Progress-mode answer block is buffered | `observed during replay` | `observed during replay` | | Buffered-block visibility receipt | `visibleReplySent: true` | `visibleReplySent: false` | | Final answer arrives in the originating topic | `No — answer absent after the run completed` | `Yes — answer received in the originating topic` | Replay prompt: `Reply with exactly: acp reply successfully` ### Real Behavior Proof (HEAD) **1. Live ACP Delivery in Bound Telegram Topic (`progress` mode)** - **Setup:** Telegram `streaming.mode: "progress"` (default), ACP persistent topic binding with live delivery (`deliveryMode: "live"`). - **Result:** The ACP reply (`acp reply successfully`) is delivered directly into the originating bound Telegram topic instead of being dropped after buffering. The artifact identifies the tested commit and correlates the originating request with the answer received in the same topic. ### Regression coverage `extensions/telegram/src/bot-message-dispatch.preview.telegram-http.test.ts` The regression (the `progress` row of "appends explicit chunks and replaces each final") covers the Telegram adapter’s visibility receipt when progress-mode answer blocks are buffered without sending their content. The intended contract is that buffering alone does not count as a visible reply, allowing ACP’s existing final-recovery mechanism to handle unsent text. The fixture accessor is corrected to `http.texts()` at both affected call sites. - Regression on BASE with the corrected fixture: ``` Test Files 1 failed (1) Tests 1 failed | 40 passed (41) ``` - Regression on HEAD: ``` Test Files 1 passed (1) Tests 41 passed (41) ``` The HTTP regression provides adapter-level proof. Live replay evidence above separately covers ACP delivery to the originating Telegram topic. ### Focused validation Tests are net 0 with no allocation file: the regression is a `progress` row in the existing explicit-chunk test, paid for by shortening one equivalent assertion. Live Telegram Test Server proof (main twice, this PR twice, plus partial/block/non-ACP controls): https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/197191#issuecomment-6815984475 ### Scope and limits The production change corrects Telegram’s visibility receipt for buffered answer blocks. It reuses ACP’s existing final-recovery mechanism. Required replay configuration: | Setting | Value | | --- | --- | | ACP`acp.stream.deliveryMode` | `live` | | Telegram streaming mode | `progress` | | ACP session binding | Persistent binding to the originating Telegram topic |
